distinct_semantics.finish_handler: Actual dtor55 rebases the parent frame, drops the 18-byte suffix at parent+0x40 then invokes root Operation with complete=false from parent+0x60; no claim for OS exception dispatch.
distinct_semantics.leaf_entry: Reject generation0 and lane>=4; locked CAS atomically validates generation, OPEN, active and unclaimed bits before any pointer load. KAT creates local authority at rsp+0x20. Bound block1..1024, bits1..block*8 and nonnull input; lane*block+ceil(bits/8)<=published width before BitString/run. Success receipt follows successful Slot::run; all admitted ordinary returns release LIVE. No host pointer is accepted here.
distinct_semantics.operation_glue: Disarmed only by low complete bit. Otherwise drop installed state at owner+0x400 unless tag=-1, set empty, clear all1024 output bytes, set phaseDead3.
distinct_semantics.panic_bridge: PrivateWaveAbort then UD2: terminating path, never counted as returning cleanup or exception recovery.
distinct_semantics.authority: Only kernel4 and health1 accepted; generation identity is additionally checked by the borrowed engine/session rather than by this shallow predicate.
distinct_semantics.plan: Specialized call accepts identity1..4, block1..1024 and computes ceil(input_bits/(block*8)), rejecting leaves>4. Writes custom/output lengths0, cancellation0 and claimed0; caller then stores claimed1. Not a general public Plan ABI.
distinct_semantics.right_encode: Clear17-byte suffix and length before construction. Width1..16, big-endian payload followed by width and stored total width+1<=17; bounded two-byte loop; shift>=128 terminates via panic bridge, not a clearing return.
distinct_semantics.bits: Specialized ABI supplies last0..8 and bounded slice lengths. Reject empty/nonempty-last mismatch, checked bit-length carry and noncanonical tail via secret predicate before returning borrowed descriptor. Not an unrestricted last-byte validator.
distinct_semantics.custom: Require Ready and Some(request); ceil(custom_bits/8)<=1024; borrow only frame+0xc0, preserve exact last-bit count and reject nonzero unused bits. No pointer to host data is returned.
distinct_semantics.state_update: Same machine code and references as sequential AVX2; current LLVM length range is narrowed to0..255. Permit, generation and state-phase checks precede absorption. Error clears owned engine/prefix and poisons state.
distinct_semantics.state_squeeze: Require squeezing phase, healthy matching authority and finalized engine. Read to separate zero-initialized1024-byte stack stage; shape/bounds or read/copy failure clears stage and poisons state. Mask partial final byte, copy exact length, clear stage and consume Core on success. Earlier caller copies/window retirement remain package08.
distinct_semantics.panic_fmt: Cold nounwind nonreturning bridge to rust_begin_unwind and UD2; debug metadata renumbering is not an ABI permission change.
distinct_semantics.panic_shift: Cold nounwind nonreturning bridge to panic_fmt and UD2; no successful cleanup claim.
distinct_semantics.core_drop: Poison engine, zero its counters, wipe memory and any pending prefix byte, zero prefix metadata, mark prefix absent and phaseDead. Full scratch lifetime also requires owning State/Core drop glue.
distinct_semantics.input_guard: Unless complete low bit is set, clear frame header128/custom1024/wave4096 at offsets0x40/0xc0/0x4c0, forget request, reset loaded bits and mark Dead2. No payload clearing implied for compiler copies outside this allocation.

caller_lifetime_composition.errors: dispatch joins before returning; failed receipts reject reduction; armed guards clear typed state
caller_lifetime_composition.partial_input: copy failure clears full fixed input regions; already copied host data is not a full-message snapshot
caller_lifetime_composition.output: exact completion then typed declassification; OS-copy failure is not transactional
caller_lifetime_composition.reuse: no slot/input/frame reuse while a Rust ticket or native worker remains live

prerequisites: original distinct root/worker windows and CPU deployment admitted before entry by C/OS
transport, native scheduler and OS/runtime calls honor their independently reviewed contracts
root remains live until every Rust ticket and native worker is quiescent; no fatal-return fiction
whole-window retirement covers moved values, compiler spills, scratch and stale stack copies
exception dispatch, fatal termination and cumulative transitive frame bounds remain package 08
public output is explicit declassification; failed OS copy may expose a prefix and is not transactional
